title: Look up ownership and abuse contact for an IP address
summary: Use whois to find out which organization owns a specific IP address. This helps identify the source of network traffic or find the abuse contact if you are receiving spam or attacks from that IP.

steps.explain: Run whois with the IP address to see the organization that owns it. Use the -b flag to specifically filter for abuse contact information, which is useful for reporting spam or attacks.

placeholders.name: IP_ADDRESS
placeholders.description: The IPv4 address to look up

steps.expect: Output showing the owning organization (e.g., Google, Cloudflare) and network range.

alternatives.explain: Use the -b flag to show only abuse contact details, which is cleaner if you just need to report an issue.

placeholders.name: IP_ADDRESS
placeholders.description: The IPv4 address to look up

alternatives.expect: Output focused on abuse email and phone numbers for the IP owner.
